'''Droideka Alpha''' was a [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]] that survived the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and was later reprogrammed to serve in [[IG-88's Droid Army]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was part of a group of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] led by IG-88 to start a [[Droid Revolution]], which was destroyed in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].
